import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quick_select_precond (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  k < v.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Quick Select on lists: pick the head as pivot, partition the tail into the
elements strictly smaller than the pivot and the rest, then recurse into the
side containing index `k` (or return the pivot when `k` is the pivot index).
The `fuel` argument only makes the recursion structural; it is always
instantiated with the length of the list. -/
def qsel : Nat → List Int → Nat → Int
  | 0, _, _ => 0
  | _ + 1, [], _ => 0
  | fuel + 1, p :: t, k =>
      let sm := t.filter (fun x => decide (x < p))
      let lg := t.filter (fun x => !decide (x < p))
      if k < sm.length then qsel fuel sm k
      else if k = sm.length then p
      else qsel fuel lg (k - sm.length - 1)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def quick_select (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) (h_precond : quick_select_precond v k) : Int :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  qsel v.toList.length v.toList k
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def quick_select_postcond (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) (result : Int) (h_precond : quick_select_precond v k) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  ∃ sorted : List Int,
    sorted.length = v.size ∧
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) sorted ∧
    sorted.getD k 0 = result ∧
    sorted.Perm v.toList
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem qsel_getD_append_right (A B : List Int) (n : Nat) (h : A.length ≤ n) :
    (A ++ B).getD n 0 = B.getD (n - A.length) 0 := by
  induction A generalizing n with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a A ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp at h
    | m + 1 =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.getD_cons_succ, List.length_cons]
      have h' : A.length ≤ m := by simpa using h
      rw [ih m h']
      congr 1
      omega

/-- Sorting `p :: t` is the same as sorting the two partition halves and
putting the pivot in between. -/
theorem qsel_sort_split (p : Int) (t : List Int) :
    List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) (p :: t) =
      List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) (t.filter (fun x => decide (x < p))) ++
        p :: List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) (t.filter (fun x => !decide (x < p))) := by
  set sm := t.filter (fun x => decide (x < p)) with hsm
  set lg := t.filter (fun x => !decide (x < p)) with hlg
  have hR : (List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm ++ p :: List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg).Perm
      (sm ++ p :: lg) :=
    (List.perm_insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm).append
      ((List.perm_insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg).cons p)
  have hM : (sm ++ p :: lg).Perm (p :: t) :=
    List.perm_middle.trans ((List.filter_append_perm _ t).cons p)
  have hperm : (List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) (p :: t)).Perm
      (List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm ++ p :: List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg) :=
    (List.perm_insertionSort (· ≤ ·) (p :: t)).trans (hR.trans hM).symm
  have hsm_lt : ∀ x ∈ List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm, x < p := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_insertionSort, hsm, List.mem_filter] at hx
    simpa using hx.2
  have hlg_ge : ∀ x ∈ List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg, p ≤ x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_insertionSort, hlg, List.mem_filter] at hx
    have := hx.2
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true', decide_eq_false_iff_not, not_lt] at this
    exact this
  have hsorted : List.Sorted (· ≤ ·)
      (List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm ++ p :: List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg) := by
    have hp : List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)
        (List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm ++ p :: List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg) := by
      rw [List.pairwise_append]
      refine ⟨List.sorted_insertionSort _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [List.pairwise_cons]
        exact ⟨hlg_ge, List.sorted_insertionSort _ _⟩
      · intro a ha b hb
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb with rfl | hb
        · exact le_of_lt (hsm_lt a ha)
        · exact le_trans (le_of_lt (hsm_lt a ha)) (hlg_ge b hb)
    exact hp
  exact List.eq_of_perm_of_sorted hperm (List.sorted_insertionSort _ _) hsorted

/-- Correctness of quick select with enough fuel. -/
theorem qsel_spec : ∀ (fuel : Nat) (l : List Int) (k : Nat),
    l.length ≤ fuel → k < l.length →
    qsel fuel l k = (List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) l).getD k 0 := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro l k hf hk
    interval_cases h : l.length
    · omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro l k hf hk
    match l with
    | [] => simp at hk
    | p :: t =>
      set sm := t.filter (fun x => decide (x < p)) with hsm
      set lg := t.filter (fun x => !decide (x < p)) with hlg
      have hlen : sm.length + lg.length = t.length := by
        have := (List.filter_append_perm (fun x => decide (x < p)) t).length_eq
        simpa [hsm, hlg] using this
      have hsmle : sm.length ≤ n := by
        have h1 : sm.length ≤ t.length := List.length_filter_le _ _
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hf
        omega
      have hlgle : lg.length ≤ n := by
        have h1 : lg.length ≤ t.length := List.length_filter_le _ _
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hf
        omega
      have hsplit := qsel_sort_split p t
      set A := List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) sm with hA
      set B := List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) lg with hB
      have hAlen : A.length = sm.length := by
        rw [hA, List.length_insertionSort]
      have hklen : k < t.length + 1 := by simpa using hk
      show (if k < sm.length then qsel n sm k
        else if k = sm.length then p
        else qsel n lg (k - sm.length - 1)) = _
      rw [hsplit]
      by_cases h1 : k < sm.length
      · rw [if_pos h1, ih sm k hsmle h1, ← hA]
        rw [List.getD_append]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg h1]
        by_cases h2 : k = sm.length
        · rw [if_pos h2, qsel_getD_append_right A _ k (by omega), hAlen]
          subst h2
          simp
        · rw [if_neg h2, qsel_getD_append_right A _ k (by omega), hAlen]
          have h3 : k - sm.length = (k - sm.length - 1) + 1 := by omega
          rw [h3, List.getD_cons_succ]
          have h4 : k - sm.length - 1 + 1 - 1 = k - sm.length - 1 := by omega
          rw [h4, hB]
          exact ih lg (k - sm.length - 1) hlgle (by omega)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem quick_select_postcond_satisfied (v : Array Int) (k : Nat) (h_precond : quick_select_precond v k) :
    quick_select_postcond v k (quick_select v k h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨List.insertionSort (· ≤ ·) v.toList, ?_, List.sorted_insertionSort _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.length_insertionSort, Array.length_toList]
  · rw [quick_select]
    exact (qsel_spec v.toList.length v.toList k le_rfl (by simpa using h_precond)).symm
  · exact List.perm_insertionSort _ _
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`./check.sh` prints **LEAN VERIFIED**.

## What I implemented

**Algorithm** (`auxcode`, `Solution.lean:16`): genuine partition-based Quick Select on `List Int`, with a `fuel` parameter only to make the recursion structural (always instantiated with the list length at the call site):

- pivot = head `p`; partition the tail into `sm = {x < p}` and `lg = {x ≥ p}`
- if `k < sm.length` recurse into `sm` with the same `k`; if `k = sm.length` return the pivot; otherwise recurse into `lg` with `k - sm.length - 1`

`quick_select` (`code`) is `qsel v.toList.length v.toList k`. No sorting, no oracle, no `Nat.find`/`Classical.choose`/`decide` in the algorithm.

**Proof** (`lemma` + `proof`):
1. `qsel_getD_append_right` — a small `getD` splitting lemma proved by induction.
2. `qsel_sort_split` — `insertionSort (p :: t) = insertionSort sm ++ p :: insertionSort lg`, proved via `List.eq_of_perm_of_sorted` (permutation from `List.filter_append_perm` + `perm_middle`; sortedness from `pairwise_append` plus the pivot bounds `x < p` on `sm`, `p ≤ x` on `lg`).
3. `qsel_spec` — by induction on fuel: for `l.length ≤ fuel` and `k < l.length`, `qsel fuel l k = (insertionSort (· ≤ ·) l).getD k 0`. Fuel adequacy comes from `length_filter_le`; the third-branch index bound from `sm.length + lg.length = t.length`.
4. The postcondition witness is `insertionSort (· ≤ ·) v.toList` — length via `length_insertionSort`, sortedness via `sorted_insertionSort`, permutation via `perm_insertionSort`, and the `getD k 0 = result` component from `qsel_spec`. The sorted list appears only as the existential witness the postcondition demands, never in the computed function.

## Semantic audit

- **Precondition `k < v.size`** is used exactly where needed (to discharge `k < v.toList.length`), and the postcondition is proved in full, unweakened form.
- **Edge cases**: negatives are fine — the algorithm compares with `<` on `Int` and the `0` fallbacks (`fuel = 0`, empty list) are provably unreachable under the precondition, so no all-negative input can return a spurious `0`; that's established by `qsel_spec` covering every `k < l.length`. Duplicates are handled correctly since `lg` keeps elements `≥ p` while the pivot itself is removed as the head.
- No helper is a placeholder: both lemmas are fully proved statements about `insertionSort`/`getD`, not `:= 0` or `:= True`.
- All four markers and the untouched `precond`/`postcond` blocks are preserved; no `sorry`, `axiom`, `partial`, or `unsafe` anywhere.

One design note worth flagging: the pivot is the first element (deterministic), so the O(N) claim holds in the average-over-inputs sense, not against an adversarially ordered input — the usual reading for this formulation.
